General Information

What is This Part?
These are the Screws that attach the Soft-top Garnish (long plastic piece) to the top of the Windshield Frame.
We specially order these in Black to match the color of the plastic.
Because they match the plastic, they don’t look out of place like the chrome screws do.
Includes the entire 8 piece set
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 8 – Soft-top Garnish Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
